mapping.state: 0 or 700 nA per physical cell; a bit is a pseudodifferential pair (700,0) or (0,700)
mapping.adc_kind: differential; one converter per cell pair output, 128 total
mapping.encoding_note: Two complementary branch-selection bits per bit; 700 nA magnitude hardwired locally. Logical INT8 signed two complement is reconstructed digitally.

write.target: both branch states settled; release complete after common control
write.verify_note: GC-04 uses current feedback/self-calibration during fine write, not a separate read/verify loop; 65 ns measured transfer settling is not all-cell BER certification
write.load_isolation: Disconnect added integration/SAR sampling capacitance during programming using local switches; source 65 ns write anchor assumes approximately original 50 fF BL load including switch parasitics. Reconnect/settle is included in dedicated read slot; if write load increases, 65 ns must be revalidated/rebudgeted.

refresh.policy: Fixed round-robin read/decode/rewrite schedule; all selected ADCs, local code bus and write drivers reserved; no demand-write refresh credits; pure sequential whole-matrix new writes may make refresh redundant, but this deliberately simple policy does not suppress it
refresh.reader: same differential ADC frontend, one row at a time; 128 bits decoded to 256 branch controls per group
refresh.reliability: 0.4 ms source: 99.7% tested +/-7 cells drift <1 source ADC LSB, not all-bit-error-free. Binary endpoint threshold at zero gives materially wider margin than MLC nearest-level rounding; tail, noise, repeated-refresh stability remain validation conditions.
refresh.sign_decode: One local binary sign decoder per differential ADC, 128 in main or 256 in wide32; one TD parallel decode, independent of 16 MVM reconstruction lanes.
refresh.phase_control: Before each fixed refresh start inhibit new batches for maximum nonpreemptive group length G; fixed order and fixed start ensure per-cell writeback period <=400 us. G is charged once per period. Establish phase after cold initialization; metrics are steady-state intervals, not first-load latency.

frontend_selection.anchor: GC-04 PDF pp6-7 Fig10: 180 ns measured whole compute cycle includes 5b SAR. It is only a complete-cycle scale anchor, not a separated device response measurement. Dedicated response 100/150/200 ns is an engineering budget for adapted binary frontend; common TI and 10b-nominal/8b-effective TA are separately added through shared API.
frontend_selection.conditions: Retain native 64-cell bitline load. MAC pulse 1 ns and single-pair refresh pulse 64 ns are explicit engineering choices; endpoint integrated charge at 700 nA is 44.8 fC in either full-scale case. The 64 ns pulse is contained in dedicated read budget, leaving 36/86/136 ns for select/settle/recovery. Integration capacitance/ADC full-scale and noise must support 129 differential levels. These pulses and dedicated budgets are not measured ported results. Each readout branch has an engineered effective 200 fF integration capacitance including bitline and sampling adaptation; 44.8 fC causes at most 224 mV discharge and +/-224 mV differential ADC swing. Both branches of 128 differential ADC frontends total 51.2 pF. This explicit local resource must be validated after parasitics/CDAC loading, not treated as free analog gain.

precision.compute: calibrated approximate ACIM; binary stored weights are sign-decoded during maintenance
precision.sum: 64 endpoint signs -> -64..64, 129 levels; recover binary sum (differential normalized sum + input popcount)/2; digital two ticks must cover this correction and plane/input reconstruction
precision.not_claimed: No DCIM exactness or universal error threshold; no all-cell retention certification

structural_comparison.note: Double true differential ADC and write-pair drivers, retain 16 digital output lanes, same physical state and capacity; frontend budget conditioned to remain 175 ns at equal 64-cell local load

exceptions.source: GC-04 pp6-7 Fig10; same BL load; doubles base row groups and evaluations

exceptions.R0: one binary cell per stored bit
exceptions.selected: two pseudodifferential 3T1C cells per bit at opposite endpoint currents
exceptions.source: GC-04 p6 Fig8; endpoint-only choice; adds actual cells and branch controls, no payload duplication

exceptions.selected: Retained. Source full 180 ns is used only as a scale anchor and is not added as a fourth stage. Shared TA genuinely propagates.
exceptions.source: GC-04 pp6-7 180 ns full cycle uses 5b ADC; our dedicated budget and 10b SAR adaptation are explicitly engineering choices.
